args.code:
# The verification logic:
# edx starts at 0x3d (61)
# For each byte of input (i=0 to 24):
#   encrypted[i] = input[i] XOR edx
#   edx = edx + input[i]
# 
# Reversing: input[i] = encrypted[i] XOR edx, then edx = edx + input[i]

encrypted = bytes([0x7b, 0xcf, 0x8e, 0x57, 0x2c, 0xbc, 0x70, 0x04, 0xbb, 0x34, 
                   0xc8, 0x1c, 0x32, 0xad, 0x6e, 0xf9, 0x8a, 0x33, 0xa5, 0x09, 
                   0x1d, 0x82, 0x53, 0xc0, 0x6b])

result = []
edx = 0x3d  # Initial value is 61 (0x3d)

for i in range(25):
    # input[i] XOR edx = encrypted[i]
    # so input[i] = encrypted[i] XOR edx
    input_byte = encrypted[i] ^ (edx & 0xff)
    result.append(input_byte)
    edx = (edx + input_byte) & 0xffffffff  # Update edx with the input byte

flag = ''.join(chr(b) for b in result)
print(f"Decrypted flag: {flag}")
print(f"Bytes: {result}")
